assessment: The 1918 volume 11 supplement first unnumbered title leaf identifies the Section of the History of Medicine, editor J. Y. W. MacAlister, and session 1917–18. The next two leaves give the officers roster headed by Raymond Crawfurd and the section contents. This is editorial front matter for a history-of-medicine supplement and contains no olive-oil intervention or Parkinson swallowing observations.
